Getting Started

Up and running in four steps

From registration to your first deposit, here is how it works.

Create your account

Register with your full name, email address, phone number and a password.

Pay the entry fee

Pay by mobile money using the code shown after registration, then upload your payment screenshot.

Get approved

An admin reviews your payment and activates your account. Your welcome bonus is added on approval.

Start managing

Sign in to deposit, withdraw, track your transactions and export statements.

If you sign in before your payment has been approved, you will be taken back to the payment step until an admin activates your account.
FAQ

Frequently asked questions

How do I activate my account?

Register, pay the entry fee using the instructions shown on the payment page, and upload a screenshot of your payment. Once an admin approves it, you can sign in and use your dashboard.

Which currency does Travolium use?

All balances, deposits, withdrawals and statements are shown in Rwandan francs (RWF).

Can I download my transaction history?

Yes. Choose Export Report on your dashboard and download your statement as a PDF or CSV file.

I forgot my password. What should I do?

Select Forgot Password on the sign-in page and enter your registered email with a new password. An admin reviews and approves the request.

How do I contact support?

After signing in, open Support Messaging to send a message to the admin team. You will receive a notification when they reply.

Admin Guide: Deleting a User Account

A short walkthrough of how to permanently remove a user from the platform.

How it works

  1. Open the Admin Panel and find the user in the Registered Accounts table.
  2. Click the red Delete button at the end of the user's row.
  3. Read the confirmation message that appears and select OK to continue, or Cancel to keep the account.
  4. The user is removed from the list immediately.
Please note: deleting an account permanently removes the user's transactions, messages and notifications. This cannot be undone. Admin accounts cannot be deleted.

Privacy Policy

Travolium Enterprise Financial Hub · Effective 15 October 2026

1. Introduction

Travolium Enterprise Financial Hub ("Travolium", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you use our website, how we use it, who can see it, and the choices you have.

2. Information we collect

  • Account details: your full name, email address, phone number and password, provided when you register.
  • Payment confirmation: the screenshot you upload to confirm that you paid the entry fee, and any proof you attach to a deposit.
  • Transaction records: deposit and withdrawal requests, including the amount, method, date and time, and approval status, as well as your welcome bonus.
  • Communications: messages you send to our support team and password reset requests.
  • Notifications and preferences: alerts we send you about your account, and your chosen light or dark display theme (saved only if you allow preference cookies).

3. How we use your information

  • To create your account and confirm your entry fee payment before activating it.
  • To review and process your deposit and withdrawal requests.
  • To show your balance, transaction history and downloadable statements (PDF and CSV).
  • To reply to your support messages and send you account notifications.
  • To handle password reset requests and to help prevent fraud and misuse.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.

4. Who can see your information

Your information is visible to you and to Travolium administrators, who need it to approve accounts, check payment proofs, process requests and provide support. We may also disclose information when the law requires it or to protect the rights and safety of our users and platform.

The entry fee is paid through a mobile money service outside this website. We do not process that payment ourselves, and the provider handles your payment details under its own privacy terms.

5. Keeping your information safe

We limit access to administrators and use the information only for the purposes above. No online service can guarantee complete security, so please keep your password confidential, do not share it with anyone, and sign out when using a shared device.

6. Cookies and browser storage

Travolium does not use advertising or tracking cookies. We use your browser's storage in two ways:

  • Essential storage: keeps your account data, your signed-in session and your cookie choice so the site works. This cannot be switched off.
  • Preference storage (optional): remembers your light or dark theme between visits. We only save this if you choose Allow.

You can change your choice at any time using Cookie Settings in the footer. If you decline, the site still works fully, but your theme returns to light each time you come back.

7. How long we keep it

We keep your information for as long as your account is active. When an administrator deletes an account, the profile, transaction history, support messages and notifications linked to that account are permanently removed.

8. Your choices and rights

  • Access: view your profile on the Security & Profile page and your transactions on your dashboard.
  • Copies: export your transaction history at any time as a PDF or CSV file.
  • Correction or deletion: ask us to correct your details or delete your account through Support Messaging.
  • Password: use "Forgot Password" on the sign-in page to request a reset.

9. Children

Travolium is intended for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version is always available from the Privacy Policy link on this website, and the effective date above shows when it was last changed.

11. Contact us

If you have any question about this policy or your personal information, send a message to our team through Support Messaging after signing in.
